predecessors.name: Roman Republic
predecessors.text: the allied Italian communities that rose in 91

successors.name: Roman Republic
successors.text: the same communities, now Roman citizens

ledger.x: 89 BC: 'Corfinium was also taken, forcing the Italians to transfer their capital to Bovianum.'
89 BC: Bovianum 'was later taken by Sulla in 89 BC, and the capital moved to Aesernia'.

90 BC: the lex Julia, 'decreed around October 90 BC', 'granted citizenship to Italian communities that had not revolted or promptly laid down arms'; Marius' and Pompeius Strabo's campaigns in the north.
89 BC: Asculum 'Surrendered in November 89 BC after its commander Vidacilius committed suicide'; the northern theatre ends.

87 BC: 'the Samnites and Lucanians were nominally pacified in 87 BC' through 'a negotiated settlement during the civil war of 87 BC, when they sided with Cinna and Marius'; the lex Plautia Papiria (89) had 'excluded the Samnites and Lucanians, who were still under arms'.
87 BC: the confederation dissolves into Roman citizen communities; Nola's holdouts and the Samnite remnant of 82 are noted, not drawn.

wars.name: Social War
wars.outcome: 'Roman victory'; citizenship for the Italians (lex Julia 90, lex Plautia Papiria 89), the Samnites and Lucanians pacified 87

certainty.note: A confederation of tribal allies, drawn as the union of their lands; which communities were in arms in a given month is not on the pages.
